# WeTravel webhook registration UX + endpoint guidance

## What to build

Extend admin integration UX to surface the WeTravel/Svix webhook endpoint instructions and registration guidance so admins can complete webhook setup and confirm webhook readiness from the app.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] App displays the correct webhook endpoint URL to register in WeTravel/Svix.
- [ ] UI includes clear setup instructions and readiness feedback for webhook registration.
- [ ] Misconfiguration states are communicated with corrective guidance.

## Blocked by
- #19 WeTravel credential onboarding + validation
